column1:
NOTE: In WooCommerce, the backend never calls cart APIs directly — it returns actions[] and the frontend calls the Store API. The same architecture should be preserved on Shopify using the Storefront AJAX API or Storefront GraphQL API.
GraphQL Storefront API endpoint: https://{store_name}.myshopify.com/api/2026-04/graphql.json

column4: Nonce + cookie auth. Body: {id: product_id, quantity: int, variation?: [{attribute, value}]}
column5:
AJAX: POST /cart/add.js
GraphQL: POST https://{store_name}.myshopify.com/api/2026-04/graphql.json
Mutation: cartLinesAdd
column6: AJAX body: {id: variant_id, quantity: int}. GraphQL: cartLinesAdd(cartId, lines:[{merchandiseId, quantity}])

column5:
AJAX: GET /cart.js
GraphQL: POST https://{store_name}.myshopify.com/api/2026-04/graphql.json
Query: cart(id: $cartId)
column6: Returns cart object with items[], total_price, etc.

column5:
Standard: Redirect to /checkout
GraphQL: POST https://{store_name}.myshopify.com/api/2026-04/graphql.json
Mutation: checkoutCreate
column6: For headless: use checkoutCreate mutation with lineItems[]. For standard: redirect to Shopify hosted checkout URL.
